title: nan
authors: Shao P.; Mo F.; Chen Y.; Ding N.; Huang R.
key_contribution: Presents a monocular semantic SLAM framework modeling 3D landmarks as quadrics and matching against an offline reference landmark map for UAV localization in GNSS-denied urban areas.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
